summary.text: Mike Steinmeyer is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 20 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Jeff Spicer is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Mike Steinmeyer served in the U.S. Navy, graduated from William Chrisman High School and earned a bachelor's degree in evangelism from Oral Roberts University.
His career experience includes working as a realtor, sales manager and trainer, and he served on the Independence City Council from 2020 to 2023.
Steinmeyer was assigned to the House Budget and Local Government committees for 2025-2026.
